title: Graduate Trainee Program 2027

questions: Based in Hong Kong, Hong Kong; that needs a visa and relocation. Is that acceptable?

reasons.love: The graduate programme rotates through operations, business development and strategy, matching his commercial interests.
reasons.good_at: The posting lists rotations but gives too little detail on skill requirements; F10, F21 and F26 provide relevant commercial and strategy evidence.
reasons.needs: The posting describes structured rotations across three functions at Lalamove, a well-established regional logistics company.
reasons.paid: estimate, HKD 18,000-26,000 per month -> about THB 92,400/month. Estimated gross monthly range for a Hong Kong graduate trainee role; the posting states no salary.

summary: Commercial rotations are attractive, but confirm visa sponsorship and whether the Hong Kong salary covers living costs.
jd_text: Lalamove Graduate Trainee Program for 2027 graduates, based in Hong Kong, starting August 2027. Rotations across operations, business development and strategy. Requirements: bachelor's degree graduating 2027; Chinese is highly preferred; English fluency. Applications close 31 December 2026.
